items.title: Microsoft Q4 Earnings Beat Estimates as Cloud and AI Drive Results
items.summary: MSFT beats Q4 estimates as cloud and AI demand lift revenues, earnings and Azure growth, while expanding AI infrastructure and raising investment plans.

items.title: LRCX Q4 Earnings Beat on NAND and Customer Support Strength
items.summary: Lam Research tops Q4 FY26 estimates as NAND revenues more than double sequentially and support sales hit a third straight record.

items.title: Can Nvidia Reclaim $5 Trillion? Jensen Huang’s Bullish AI Call Says Yes
items.summary: Jensen Huang just called AI infrastructure the largest expansion in human history, yet NVIDIA shares sit $20 below a $5 trillion market cap. Here is what would need to go right and what could blow it all up.

items.title: Chip Stocks Boost Tech-Led Rebound Rally at Software’s Expense
items.summary: The tech sector was leading today’s stock market bounce back, and chip stocks were a standout group.  Tech was the top performing sector in the S&P 500 by a large margin.  The State Street Technology Select Sector SPDR ETF was up 4.9%, while the next best performing sectors saw less than 1% in gains.

items.title: TENB Q2 Earnings Beat on Tenable One Momentum, Outlook Raised
items.summary: Tenable beats Q2 earnings and revenue estimates as record Tenable One adoption, AI momentum and customer expansion fuel growth and lift its outlook.

items.title: Fortinet Q2 Earnings & Revenues Beat Estimates, Increase Y/Y
items.summary: FTNT tops Q2 earnings and revenue estimates as strong AI infrastructure, SASE and OT security demand lift results and prompt higher 2026 guidance.

items.title: KLA Stock Is Having Its Worst Month Ever. Why Earnings Can’t Stop the Selloff.
items.summary: Susquehanna analyst Mehdi Hosseini believes the company’s growth is constrained even as KLA issues an upbeat forecast.
